messages:
ana: Heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a p95 spike on small-batch runs for model-1 (commit 9f3b2a1). Graphs: https://grafana.redwood/board/d/abcd123/p95-dashboard :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ana: CI alert summary: p95 went from ~120ms -> ~420ms between runs 03:00–03:10. nightly-run id 2026-03-17_03:05. Artifacts uploaded.
ci-bot: nightly-perf-check failed — artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/2026-03-17/2026-03-17_03:05.tar.gz
matt: putting on 3am watch. do we have a bisect candidate range?
sophia: 9f3b2a1 is in the window. suspect kernel scheduler tweak from infra PR #1423 but that's a guess.
ken: grabbing logs, running repro with batch size 8 locally. can someone post the exact bench command?
ana: bench cmd in infra/run_bench.sh — uses --seq 1024 --batch 8 --model model-1. paste:
```bash
./run_bench.sh --model model-1 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --runs 5 --tag nightly-2026-03-17
```
ken: repro started, will update.
infra-bot: repro runner started on g4dn-type-3 instance (i-0a1b2c3). PID 4521.
luis: if repro shows same spike, try setting TF_ENABLE_SCHED=0? (rant) but let's not change infra without ops.
matt: if it's infra scheduler related, we should check recent kernel packages — /changelog shows newer preempt config in node image built 2026-03-16.
sophia: can someone pull the profile traces? nightly artifacts include /profiles/p95.stack.gz
ci-bot: uploaded profiles to s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/2026-03-17/profiles/9f3b2a1/p95.stack.gz
ken: local run matches: median ~110ms, p95 ~410ms, tails show repeated kernel preempt. attaching top lines:
```
[ 03:05:12 ] preempt_schedule_common+0x... kernel_preempt
[ 03:05:12 ] napi_poll -> schedule -> preempt
```
ana: ok that narrows it. matt, can infra roll back kernel image for the smoke pool?
matt: ops, we can rollback the node image to build-2026-03-15 for a small canary group. assigning to infra-oncall @ken?
ken: i'm on it. spinning up 2-node canary with old image, will run the bench now.
sophia: also let's bisect commits between 9f3b2a1 and previous nightly. quick bisect hint: run bench with --cpu-affinity pinned to avoid scheduler noise. try:
```bash
taskset -c 0-7 ./run_bench.sh --model model-1 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --runs 5
```
ken: pinned run completed — p95 back to ~125ms. looks like kernel change is culprit.
matt: good. infra-oncall, please schedule a controlled rollback and patch release note. Ops checklist: 1) canary rollback 2) run 3 nightly runs 3) promote image 4) notify customers if SLAs affected.
infra-bot: rollback in progress — 2 canary nodes switched to build-2026-03-15-image.
ana: thanks. teams: add a follow-up to postmortems board and create a retro. Assign to matt/sophia.
luis: quick note — we should add kernel-version to nightly metadata so future alerts show it in the main graph. filed RFC: registry#214.
sophia: agreed. also let's add an automated affinity run as part of the perf-check to catch scheduler regressions. filed perf-run#87.
matt: rolling back to old image fixed canary bench — p95 ~118ms across 3 runs. marking alert resolved. :white_check_mark:
ana: amazing, thank you everyone. closing thread after ops confirms full rollout.
infra-bot: full pool rollout scheduled at 03:25 UTC.
matt: done, rollout finished. no further alerts.
ana: closed. :v:
